sources.entry: astropy - A community Python library for astronomy.

summary.one_liner: Astropy is a community-developed core Python library for astronomy that aims to provide a single base package and improve interoperability between astronomy tools.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes this repository as the core Astropy library, developed by the Astropy Project as a community effort. It is installable from PyPI with pip. The README points to external documentation, an install guide, a developer guide, and contribution guidelines, but it does not list specific astronomy features or modules. Links are provided for Slack, an Open Astronomy Discourse forum, and users and developers mailing lists. It also mentions a GitHub Codespaces dev container for contributors and a citation guide.
use_cases: contribute to open source astronomy software
set up a cloud dev environment for astropy
notable: Community-developed core package intended as a shared base for astronomy in Python
Installable from PyPI with a single pip command
Provides a dev container for cloud development via GitHub Codespaces
Asks contributors to follow an AI policy and code of conduct, with a citation guide (Zenodo DOI)
caveats: README does not list specific features or modules, so capabilities must be checked in the external docs
Detailed installation instructions are located in the external install guide
